notes.title: Huge Update
notes.content:
After a longer break, I would like to present to you a new update that significantly impacts the gameplay, bringing diversity and adding new functionalities. Below is the list of new features:

-Enemies can drop grenades upon death. There are three types of grenades that, when collected, have different effects: freezing enemies, igniting enemies, and exploding with an impulse.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876820/fcb652d80d1235cf28774abec7e98b56c0499684.gif

-Enemies can drop new items upon death:

 a)Magnet: attracts all items on the map.
 b)Infinite ammo for 30 seconds.
 c)Medkit: heals the player.


-Introducing the new "Combo" mechanic. Now, destroyed enemies are counted, and upon reaching a count of 20 without losing health, the player receives increased speed and damage.

-New passive weapon: Rocket Launcher. Rockets automatically target enemies and attack them without player intervention.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876820/2a03f711657ee6554c52f05fd06dfcb8885e7828.gif

-The game now offers a windowed view option in the settings.

-Towers now have their own health bar, which regenerates after being upgraded.

-A completely new type of enemy that throws poison at the player.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876820/2479d3ba1bda7c63d22e5c68abbae7ba706d680d.gif

-Towers now find the shortest rotation path when selecting a new target for attack.

-Missing sounds have been added to the game.

-Added support for gamepad controls.

-Four bosses have been added, appearing in certain campaign levels as well as the survival mode.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876820/d9e667bb6ed616f46f9b8b68faa2e854140f045d.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876820/d0ec484d6e36fd08c33ea68646b21c151dde3112.gif

-Significant improvements in game optimization.

-Gameplay balance has been improved.

-A completely new gameplay mechanic: Every 60 seconds, the player is given the opportunity to randomly select a gameplay modifier. Some modifiers benefit the player, while others may make the gameplay more challenging. There are a total of 15 modifiers to choose from. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876820/2a808672b720b74873ecd83572db5f8507596992.gif

Here are a few examples:

 a) "Storm is Coming": Enemies take damage from lightning.
 b) "This is How It's Born": Enemies spawn eggs that hatch into new enemies when collected.
 c) "What Do They Feed Them?": Enemies are 3 times larger.
 d) "Lucky Day": Enemies spawn 3 times more coins.


-Fixed a lot of bugs
